A MAHA win for South Carolina: Our state is cutting sugary drinks and candy out of SNAP, starting August 31st.

This is common sense. Food assistance should help families put nutritious food on the table, not subsidize soda and candy while we're in the middle of a childhood obesity crisis. SNAP-enrolled kids in South Carolina already consume 43% more sugary drinks than their peers.

South Carolina is putting the health of its families FIRST.
